test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the correct statement when fitting rings in an internal combustion (IC) engine?

options.text: Cleaning the piston head sealing surface area thoroughly is required.
Use of specialised tools to install the rings without twisting or damaging them is essential
This is vital for maintaining proper combustion pressure and preventing oil consumption issues.
The most crucial precaution is to ensure proper ring gap and alignment by carefully checking the end gap of each ring.

solution:
The correct answer is __Cleaning the piston head sealing surface area thoroughly is required**(Option 1)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fitting rings in an internal combustion engine__ requires careful handling and proper tools to avoid damage.
 
• Specialised tools are essential for installing the rings without twisting or damaging them.
 
• Proper ring gap and alignment are crucial, requiring careful checking of the end gap of each ring.
 
• This ensures proper combustion pressure and prevents oil consumption issues.
 
• Cleaning the piston head sealing surface area thoroughly, however, is not specifically related to the process of fitting rings.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Ring Installation:**

 
 
• Ensures optimal engine performance and longevity.
 
• Prevents oil leakage and excessive oil consumption.
 
 
 
• **Precautions:**
 
 
• Avoid twisting or forcing the rings during installation.
 
• Use tools designed specifically for ring installation.
